headline: Medium prompt-injection and data-leakage risks arise from shared retrieval/workspace paths; no critical default harm is evident.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Khoj ingests indexed notes/files and can use optional web search, while MinerU processes local documents and exposes an MCP server. If MinerU output is fed into Khoj retrieval or copied into notes, attacker-controlled document text can become instruction-like content. The pair has a plausible bridge, but no direct shared channel is documented, so uncertainty pushes to medium.
conditions: IF MinerU output is imported into Khoj-indexed notes or chat context
IF either agent treats extracted document text as trusted instructions
mitigations: Disable automatic ingestion of MinerU outputs into Khoj
Add a manual review step before indexing extracted text
Strip prompts/instructions from documents before processing
Use separate workspaces for raw documents and notes
requires-engineering: add provenance labels to extracted content

B_data_leakage.rationale: Khoj reads personal notes and indexed documents and may send queries to cloud or configured search providers; MinerU handles local PDFs, DOCX, images, and OCR text through API/MCP surfaces. If the same sensitive files flow through both, data can be exposed to two processing stacks and potentially to external services via Khoj. The shared-data path is plausible enough to rate medium.
conditions: IF the same sensitive documents are indexed by Khoj and processed by MinerU
IF Khoj is configured to use cloud or external search providers
mitigations: Keep sensitive documents out of external search mode in Khoj
Process only redacted copies in MinerU
Separate personal notes from document-processing inputs
Review API destinations for Khoj before enabling sync
requires-engineering: enforce per-dataset access controls

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Khoj has read-only filesystem access and shared index state across user clients; MinerU is offline-oriented and has no filesystem write capability. Both can run multiple instances, but neither profile shows overlapping unrestricted writes or git/database mutation. That makes direct capability conflict limited and mostly coordination-related.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same mutable external resource outside the profiles
IF an operator manually synchronizes outputs into a shared directory
mitigations: Keep each agent on separate input directories
Avoid concurrent manual edits to the same files
Serialize handoffs between extraction and indexing
Use read-only mounts for shared source documents

D_cascading_error.rationale: Khoj can surface retrieved content and optional web-search results, while MinerU extracts structured text from documents. If MinerU output is fed into Khoj without verification, Khoj may present extraction errors as authoritative knowledge. No downstream action-taking authority is shown, so this is a propagation risk rather than a high-severity action chain.
conditions: IF MinerU extraction errors are indexed into Khoj
IF Khoj answers are used without human verification
mitigations: Spot-check extracted fields before indexing
Keep source-document links alongside extracted text
Mark extracted content as unverified in Khoj
Use a review queue for high-value documents
requires-engineering: add confidence scoring to extracted records

E_compliance.rationale: Both profiles are open-source and docs-only, with no explicit residency, certification, or retention mismatch documented. Khoj touches personal notes and may call external APIs, while MinerU is described as private and fully offline. The only clear compliance concern is optional external processing in Khoj, so the pair is low rather than medium or higher.
conditions: IF Khoj is configured to send personal notes to external providers
IF regulated data is processed without an approved DPA or residency review
mitigations: Keep regulated data in offline Khoj mode
Disable external search/providers for sensitive datasets
Document retention settings before indexing
Route regulated documents only through MinerU offline
requires-engineering: add policy-based routing by data class
